+title: A check that fails when a unit test sends a request to the Hugging Face Hub
+---
+## What
+The TestudoApp session asks for a check that fails if a Router unit test reaches the network (the Hub), if practical. The unit tests with a fake hub cache now give `offline: true` (^688b96g). This check keeps it so.
+
+First find out how the Extras hub source sends its requests (../FoundationModelsExtras, the Hub client, swift-huggingface in .build/checkouts): does it use `URLSession.shared`, its own session, an endpoint setting, or a seam that a test can see?
+
+Then choose the most reliable practical check, for example:
+- a `URLProtocol` that records each request, if the Hub client session uses the registered protocol classes;
+- an endpoint setting that a test can give;
+- else a source check (a unit test that reads the unit test files and fails when a hub loader init with a cache directory has no `offline: true`).
+
+If no check is practical, record why on this task and close it with no code change.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] The check fails when a unit test makes a Hub request (prove it: make it fail one time on purpose, then remove that).
+- [ ] The check does not apply to FoundationModelsRouterRealModelSupport and the real-model suites.
+- [ ] No process environment change (no `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` set by tests).
+- [ ] Full `swift test` green. #router-3
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7je8kqe357efb0kamsjsrt6
+  text: |-
+    Research (Extras 2f64483 in .build/checkouts):
+    - `HubSource.session` is `URLSession(configuration: .default)` (internal stored default). `ModelStorage` also makes `URLSession(configuration: .default)`. `HubClient(session:host:...)` and `ResumableFileDownload` use that session. The host is `HF_ENDPOINT` from the process environment, else `HubClient.defaultHost` (huggingface.co). Router `HuggingFaceMetadataSource` defaults to `URLSession.shared`.
+    - Measured (scratch program): `URLProtocol.registerClass` reaches `URLSession.shared` only. A `URLSession(configuration: .default)` does NOT see a registered protocol and sent a real request. Thus a registered `URLProtocol` alone is not a check.
+    - An endpoint setting is only `HF_ENDPOINT` (process environment): forbidden by the card.
+    - The session seam is internal and is made inside the public init of `HubModelLoader`; a test that forgets `offline: true` also forgets a seam. Not a global check.
+    - A source check is forbidden by the TDD rule "Create tests that scan the source itself and assert on source strings".
+    - Chosen check (measured on a scratch package with Swift 6.4.2): a `URLProtocol` guard in the unit test target. It exchanges the implementation of `URLSessionConfiguration.default` (ObjC runtime) so each default configuration puts the guard first, and it registers the guard for `URLSession.shared`. The guard takes only requests to the Hub host, records an `Issue` with the URL, and fails the request with `URLError(.notConnectedToInternet)`, thus no request leaves the process. A module initializer (`@section("__DATA,__mod_init_func") @used static let` with a `@convention(c)` closure, no flag needed on Swift 6.4) arms the guard when the test bundle loads, before any test. Swift Testing has no process-start hook; this is the hook.
+    - Measured: an issue recorded on a URL loading thread shows as "Test «unknown» recorded an issue" and fails the run; `withKnownIssue` does not catch it (other thread). Thus the guard's own tests check the configuration and `canInit(with:)`, not a real request.
+    - Scope: the root package links every test target into one test bundle (unit, public-surface, hermetic evals): all hermetic. Real-model suites are in the nested IntegrationTests package (own bundle), and the guard is not in RealModelSupport, so it does not apply there.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-16T15:05:30.094630+00:00
